Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL4649969. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, and to compound_structures on molregno (inner join). Filter by assay CHEMBL4649969 and require exact activity values (standard_relation '=' and standard_value not null). Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
